adonis.excerpt: Ethan stands out for his remarkable autonomy and a rare ability to analyze very large areas of code, from mobile to backend to front end. […] I recommend him without the slightest hesitation.
adonis.text: I had the chance to work with Ethan Boulard on my team, and I can say without hesitation that he is an exceptional asset. Ethan stands out for his remarkable autonomy and a rare ability to analyze very large areas of code, from mobile to backend to front end. He always brings precise and relevant expertise, both on complex technical issues and on visual details, which is quite rare. Beyond his technical skills, Ethan has an excellent sense of teamwork. He adapts to different profiles, collaborates effectively and contributes to a healthy, productive dynamic. Throughout our collaboration, we never heard a single complaint from him, though he will give you feedback if you ask for it. We now have to part ways with him solely for financial reasons, due to a lack of funds within the company, a difficult decision given the quality of his work. It is with regret that I let him go, and I sincerely hope to have the opportunity to work with Ethan again very soon. I recommend him without the slightest hesitation.

prescillia.excerpt: Creative, flexible and attentive, he took every piece of feedback on board to deliver quality work, a real asset to the team. […] He will be a true added value to any team lucky enough to have him.
prescillia.text: I had the pleasure of working with Ethan during his internship at Inside Runway, where he assisted our CTO and contributed to the development of our platform, notably the mobile app. Creative, flexible and attentive, he took every piece of feedback on board to deliver quality work, a real asset to the team. I highly recommend Ethan to anyone looking for a developer who combines solid skills with an excellent mindset. He will be a true added value to any team lucky enough to have him.
